phases.name: Core Loop Lockdown
phases.goal: Prove the game is fun single-player before networking

slices.title: Movement Controller Feel Pass
acceptance_criteria: Play-test 10 minutes solo — no network, no customization loaded
Subjective feel note before/after tuning
No clipping through 20x20 test-room geometry at max speed
slices.notes: Implemented: @export turn_speed, 120ms timed input buffer for attack/dodge during lockout, get_movement_tuning_snapshot(). Verification steps pending.

slices.title: Combat Hit Registration
acceptance_criteria: Automated test: dummy at 3 distances — exactly 1 hit per swing, 0 on miss
No tunneling at high player movement speed
slices.git_commit: Slice 0.2: Fix hit registration and prevent multi-hit
slices.notes: Hitbox/Hurtbox components with per-swing dedup; test_hit_registration.tscn for edge/center/miss. High-speed tunneling verification pending.

slices.title: Stagger / Knockback Tuning
acceptance_criteria: Three attack weight classes produce distinct knockback distances (logged)
Player cannot act during stagger window (input suppressed)
slices.git_commit: Slice 0.3: Tune stagger/knockback by attack weight
slices.notes: Basic knockback on velocity exists; no is_staggered input block

slices.title: Customization System Render Correctness
acceptance_criteria: Zero shader compiles mid-match after boot warmup
No missing textures/purple materials on any combination
slices.notes: CustomizationManager applies textures on-demand; no pre-instance cache

slices.title: Solo Core Loop Acceptance Pass
acceptance_criteria: 3 independent playtesters, 10 minutes solo each
Net-positive 'would I play this again' rating
Document game-feel issues as new slices

phases.name: Multiplayer Core
phases.goal: Real-time synced matches over Supabase Realtime on mobile networks

slices.title: Player State Sync Channel
acceptance_criteria: Two devices: position update <150ms on WiFi
Broadcast messages do not write to database
slices.git_commit: Slice 1.1: Player state sync via Supabase Broadcast
slices.notes: network_manager.gd has ENet stub; no realtime_sync.gd

slices.title: Client-Side Interpolation
acceptance_criteria: Throttled network: remote player moves smoothly
Out-of-order packets discarded, no rubber-banding

slices.title: App Lifecycle Reconnect Handling
acceptance_criteria: 15s background: reconnect within 3s, state agrees
60s background: graceful reconnect or clear UI, no silent desync
slices.git_commit: Slice 1.3: Handle app pause/resume for match reconnection

slices.title: Match Room / Lobby Lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Both players leave: channel unsubscribed
Third player cannot join IN_MATCH lobby

slices.title: Phase 1 Acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Full match on 2 real Android devices with backgrounding
Zero permanent desyncs, zero crashes

phases.name: Rumble Mode Complete
phases.goal: Synchronized rumble matches with server-validated outcomes

slices.title: Match Start/Countdown Flow
acceptance_criteria: Two devices with different join times: countdown in visual sync (~1 frame)

slices.title: Win/Loss Condition Logic
acceptance_criteria: Scripted test: all win paths agree across connected clients

slices.title: Rep Reward Pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Direct client rep write rejected
Legitimate match completion increments rep exactly once

slices.title: Phase 2 Acceptance
acceptance_criteria: 2+ Android devices: full rumble lobby to rep award, zero dev console

phases.name: Performance Validation
phases.goal: Sustained 60fps on Pixel 6a under full match load

slices.title: Confirm Mobile Renderer Path
acceptance_criteria: project.godot renderer set to mobile
Runtime log confirms mobile renderer on boot
slices.git_commit: Slice 3.1: Lock and assert mobile renderer path
slices.notes: Mobile feature tag set; no startup assertion yet

slices.title: Shader Warmup Coverage Audit
acceptance_criteria: Zero shader compiles after loading screen in full match
slices.git_commit: Slice 3.2: Extend shader warmup to combat/environment assets

slices.title: Draw Call and Texture Memory Profiling
acceptance_criteria: Sustained frame time <16.6ms worst-case
Texture memory within documented budget
slices.git_commit: Slice 3.3: Profile and optimize for Pixel 6a baseline

slices.title: Phase 3 Acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Full rumble on Pixel 6a, 95th percentile frame time <16.6ms

phases.name: Backend Hardening
phases.goal: RLS, auth abuse resistance, adversarial validation

slices.title: Row Level Security Policy Audit
acceptance_criteria: Cross-account read/write rejected for rep, inventory, match history
Anonymous client rejected except deliberate public data
slices.git_commit: Slice 4.1: Audit and lock down RLS policies

slices.title: Auth Abuse Testing
acceptance_criteria: Rapid sign-up rate-limited
Expired/tampered token rejected on privileged calls
slices.git_commit: Slice 4.2: Rate-limit and validate auth flows

slices.title: Phase 4 Adversarial Pass
acceptance_criteria: All attack attempts documented and fail

slices.title: Play Console Data Safety Form
acceptance_criteria: Form matches Supabase schema and analytics
slices.git_commit: Slice 5.1: Complete Play Console data safety declaration

slices.title: Privacy Policy and Content Rating
acceptance_criteria: Privacy policy URL loads and is accurate
Content rating questionnaire submitted
slices.git_commit: Slice 5.2: Privacy policy and content rating

slices.title: Release Signing and AAB Export
acceptance_criteria: AAB builds from release preset
Keystore backed up in 2+ secure locations
slices.git_commit: Slice 5.3: Configure release signing and AAB export

slices.title: Pre-Launch Report Pass
acceptance_criteria: Internal track pre-launch report: zero blocking issues

phases.name: Closed Test
phases.goal: External testers, crash reporting, stability bar

slices.title: Crash Reporting Integration
acceptance_criteria: Forced test crash produces usable stack trace report

slices.title: Closed Testing Track Launch
acceptance_criteria: External non-developer testers install and play full match

slices.title: Phase 6 Stability Bar
acceptance_criteria: Crash-free sessions >= 99%
Zero open P0 bugs

slices.title: Store Listing Assets
acceptance_criteria: Listing preview reviewed on phone and tablet

slices.title: Staged Rollout
acceptance_criteria: Crash/ANR healthy 48-72h before increasing rollout %
